dataPolicy: Portfolio-safe project summary only. No private Strava tokens or personal raw activity exports are included.

thoughtProcess.title: Start with authorized activity data
thoughtProcess.body: Use the Strava API as the source of activity records so the interface can reflect real workouts without manual file handling.

thoughtProcess.title: Transform routes for the browser
thoughtProcess.body: Convert activity and route metadata into map-ready structures that a Leaflet.js frontend can render as layers.

thoughtProcess.title: Design for spatial interpretation
thoughtProcess.body: Prioritize map controls and overlays that help users see repeated routes, high-density areas, and activity behavior patterns.

thoughtProcess.title: Keep the app lightweight
thoughtProcess.body: Use Flask, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript so the project stays simple to run, inspect, and extend.

workflow.detail: Connect the app to authorized Strava activity records.
Retrieve route and workout metadata for analysis.
Prepare activity points and route data for browser rendering.
Serve the app views and data endpoints for the frontend.
Display map layers, heatmap overlays, and route behavior patterns.

layers.detail: Highlights corridors where repeated activities concentrate across the map.
Emphasizes common starting areas and recurring launch points for activities.
Frames the visualization around repeated user movement patterns and spatial habits.
